title: Rav Ada bar Ahavah (III)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as Rav Papa’s student, citing [Chullin 133b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.133b.6), where he acted as an interpreter before Rav Papa. In [Sanhedrin 36a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.36a.13) he said: “From the days of Rabbi until Rav Ashi we do not find Torah and greatness in one place.” But in [Gittin 59a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.59a.9) the reading is Rav Acha son of Rava.[^1]

notes.text: Sanhedrin gives the saying to Rav Ada bar Ahavah; Gittin gives it to Rav Acha son of Rava. Both passages continue by distinguishing Huna bar Natan, who deferred to Rav Ashi.
